metadata.title: EscapeMate — Find your next raid squad
metadata.description: Swipe, match, and squad up with compatible Escape from Tarkov players.

landing.heroImageAlt: Fictional tactical table for planning raids
landing.headline: Find raid teammates before going in blind.
landing.description: Swipe Escape from Tarkov players who match you by language, region, schedule, maps, playstyle and PvP or PvE mode. Mutual interest opens the chat and their Discord.

profile.title: Create your raid profile
profile.text: Maps, playstyle, goals, schedule, languages and mode. Optionally connect your tarkov.dev stats.

swipe.title: Swipe compatible players
swipe.text: Every card shows why you match and what to watch out for.

play.title: Match and raid
play.text: A mutual like unlocks chat and their Discord. Agree on a time and map, and go.

landing.featuresTitle: Everything you need to stop playing solo

compatibility.title: Real compatibility
compatibility.text: A 0–100 score from language, region, schedule, goals, maps, playstyle and real experience. You're only paired with players in your mode.

raidNow.title: Raid now
raidNow.text: Want to play right now? Post a 90-minute search, receive requests and accept whoever fits.

questHelp.title: Quest help
questHelp.text: Ask for or offer help with a specific quest. It detects the quest's map and blocks RMT.

chat.title: Chat and Discord on match
chat.text: Nobody sees your Discord until there's mutual interest or you accept their request.

landing.safety: No payments or RMT. Block or report anyone in one click and delete your account whenever you want. Not affiliated with Battlestate Games.

finalCta.title: Your next duo is one swipe away
finalCta.text: Creating your profile takes a minute.

demoBanner: Local demo mode: all data is fake and lives in memory. Nothing is saved to Supabase.

responses.accepted: You're in! The chat is open.
responses.declined: The author didn't accept your request this time.
responses.pending: Request sent. We'll let you know when it's accepted.

messagePlaceholder.raid_now: E.g. I have comms, level 30, ready in 5 min
messagePlaceholder.quest_help: E.g. Already done it, I'll show you the route

responses.none: No requests yet. The navigation badge will tell you when one arrives.

errorPage.title: Something went wrong
errorPage.description: We couldn't load this screen. Try again; if it keeps happening, give it a few minutes.
errorPage.notFoundDescription: The link may have expired, the post may be closed or the match may no longer be available.
